lines.text: Coop Tracker. Co-op finance, without the spreadsheets.
One place for members, loans and dividends.
The dashboard shows the whole co-op, and who has paid this period.
Mark collections, and see every member's shares.
Follow every loan, then share out the interest.
The interest pool, divided by every eligible share.
Computed, not guessed, and tested first.
Coop Tracker. Designed and built by Keith Vergara.
